answer: The quill schedule is applied in pulse and trellis exposes each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1795 identities would post 1862 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
